scope: New cache replacement plans freeze all instance display fonts and default inheritance flags, then compare the full native table after independent reopen.
Custom Value display uses a real font-edit task before replacement, in addition to original Unicode user overrides and rotated display layout.
Legacy expected-state records without fonts remain supported at their original scope. The optional result flag certifies only snapshots actually compared.
The old heterogeneous unbound GND failure, occurrence inheritance, unrelated vector graphs and rendering remain unresolved.
